## Worldwide Logistics, Government, Marine and Energy Solutions

**People who know Crowley, know our employees are among the most knowledgeable and customer-focused
in the industries we serve. They appreciate that we go places and solve problems others can’t. That

#### **Crowley Mariners Honored with Gallant Ship Award on National Maritime Day**

Crowley mariners who served aboard the U.S.-flagged tanker Stena Immaculate were honored with the
U.S. Maritime Administration’s (MARAD) Gallant Ship Award during the U.S. Department of
Transportation’s National Maritime Day observance in Washington, D.C. The award, one of the maritime
industry’s highest distinctions, recognizes the 23-member crew’s extraordinary professionalism,
courage and commitment to safety.

[Read the Full press Release>][72]

#### **Crowley’s First Avance Class Vessel Quetzal Begins Maiden Commercial Voyage**

Crowley’s new LNG-powered containership Quetzal has successfully begun its inaugural commercial
voyage, opening the company’s next era of faster, frequent ocean shipping with a new class of
vessels for the U.S., Central America and the Dominican Republic.

With capacity for up to 1,400 20-foot container equivalent units (TEUs), Quetzal and its three
forthcoming sister Avance Class ships will provide more cargo capacity while using lower-emissions
liquefied natural gas (LNG) for fuel. Quetzal and its sister ships were specifically designed to
accommodate a variety of container sizes, including 300 refrigerated container unit plugs.

[Read More >][73]

#### **Crowley Mariners Honored with Gallant Ship Award on National Maritime Day**

Crowley mariners who served aboard the U.S.-flagged tanker Stena Immaculate were honored with the
U.S. Maritime Administration’s (MARAD) Gallant Ship Award during the U.S. Department of
Transportation’s National Maritime Day observance in Washington, D.C. The award, one of the maritime
industry’s highest distinctions, recognizes the 23-member crew’s extraordinary professionalism,
courage and commitment to safety.

[Read the Full press Release>][72]

#### **Crowley’s First Avance Class Vessel Quetzal Begins Maiden Commercial Voyage**

Crowley’s new LNG-powered containership Quetzal has successfully begun its inaugural commercial
voyage, opening the company’s next era of faster, frequent ocean shipping with a new class of
vessels for the U.S., Central America and the Dominican Republic.

With capacity for up to 1,400 20-foot container equivalent units (TEUs), Quetzal and its three
forthcoming sister Avance Class ships will provide more cargo capacity while using lower-emissions
liquefied natural gas (LNG) for fuel. Quetzal and its sister ships were specifically designed to
accommodate a variety of container sizes, including 300 refrigerated container unit plugs.

# We are Seaspan

With more than a century of experience operating up and down the coast of Western Canada, Seaspan
plays a vital role in Canada’s marine sector: designing, building, and repairing ships, and
transporting goods, materials, and fuel safely and efficiently through the Pacific Northwest.

## Seaspan Shipyards

[joint support ships under construction underneath big blue]

Located on the Pacific Northwest Coast, Seaspan’s Shipyards are an important resource for the
region’s marine industry. Seaspan Shipyards operations include Vancouver Shipyards, Vancouver
Drydock and Victoria Shipyards.

[Seaspan Shipyards][42]

## Seaspan Marine

[aerial view of seaspan tugs docked at head office]

Seaspan Marine offers ship assist, coastal and deep-sea transportation, and fuel bunkering services
on Canada’s West Coast, and daily commercial ferry services supporting the Vancouver Island supply
chain.

[Seaspan Marine][43]
[Seaspan Ferries][44]

## News

[ [Seaspan delivers fourth ship under the National Shipbuilding Strategy, the Canadian Coast Guard’s

Providing sustainable marine services and towage infrastructure

## Leading sustainable marine services

Founded in 1833, Svitzer builds on almost 200 years of experience, and our powerful tugboats and
experts in towage work tirelessly to keep goods flowing, businesses thriving, and communities
connected. Today, Svitzer is a leading global port and terminal infrastructure provider, serving
approximately 2,000 customers in 157 ports and 46 terminals across 38 countries through a fleet of
510 vessels.

Consent Required

## TRAnsverse tug: Redefining Towage

With its revolutionary design, Svitzer’s TRAnsverse tug takes manoeuvrability and towing
capabilities to the next level.
Read the evidence in the White Paper, which includes data from sea trials and from the tug’s
operations.
At speeds above 2-3 knots in dynamic modes, the TRAnsverse tug expands the operating envelope by
around 50% compared to similar or larger size standard ASD tug designs. Further, the TRAnsverse tug
has shown a fuel efficiency gain of 15%.
The TRAnsverse tug: Redefining towage and only possible with Svitzer.

Gastrade’s Alexandroupolis Independent Natural Gas System (Alexandroupolis INGS) LNG terminal, the

truly customised solution for Gastrade, with the delivery of four brand new tugs operated by our
local Greek team.

## This is our role in the energy transition

As the world evolves towards a sustainable economy, we embrace and expand our role as an initiator
and enabler of positive change. In fact, we are actively shaping a sustainable future – for example,
by advancing partnerships that accelerate the development of infrastructure for the energy
transition. In this we focus on zero- and low-carbon hydrogen, ammonia, CO2, battery energy storage
and sustainable feedstocks.

[ Learn more ][29]

### Sustainability

We are ambitious and performance driven with a balanced roadmap focusing on care for people, planet
and profit.

[ Learn more about sustainability ][30]

### Careers

Working at Vopak means adding value to people’s lives, as we store and handle products that are
vital for our everyday life.

[ Go to our careers page ][31]

## Volunteering for Vopak communities

Vopak encourages employees to take an active part in their local communities. The common vehicle to
help engage with our communities is the Vopak WeConnect, which supports employees in setting up
sustainable projects to empower young people and to contribute to sustainable communities, in
cooperation with local schools, community groups or NGOs.

[ Vopak WeConnect ][32]

## This is our role in the energy transition

As the world evolves towards a sustainable economy, we embrace and expand our role as an initiator
and enabler of positive change. In fact, we are actively shaping a sustainable future – for example,
by advancing partnerships that accelerate the development of infrastructure for the energy
transition. In this we focus on zero- and low-carbon hydrogen, ammonia, CO2, battery energy storage
and sustainable feedstocks.

[ Learn more ][29]

### Sustainability

We are ambitious and performance driven with a balanced roadmap focusing on care for people, planet
and profit.

[ Learn more about sustainability ][30]

### Careers

Working at Vopak means adding value to people’s lives, as we store and handle products that are
vital for our everyday life.

[ Go to our careers page ][31]

## Volunteering for Vopak communities

Vopak encourages employees to take an active part in their local communities. The common vehicle to
help engage with our communities is the Vopak WeConnect, which supports employees in setting up
sustainable projects to empower young people and to contribute to sustainable communities, in
cooperation with local schools, community groups or NGOs.

[ Vopak WeConnect ][32]

Would you like to get in touch with us?

## Money transfer in the UAE

For 60 years, Al Ansari Exchange has been the leading exchange company in the UAE. We provide online
money transfer services, online and offline remittance, foreign exchange services and much more to
thousands of customers every day.

We boast the largest network of branches in the UAE, connecting millions of people around the globe.
Apart from offering the best way to transfer money from the UAE, our wide range of financial
services also includes prepaid cards, corporate payment solutions, and bill payments. Moreover, our
mobile app enables you to quickly and securely access those services. Money transfer has never been
so convenient.

Ampelmann is the global leader in Walk to Work solutions, operating motion compensated offshore
access systems and services all over the world.

[

## Who we are

In an ever-changing energy market, Ampelmann is committed to providing the best access solutions and
services for people and cargo transfer. We have changed the world of offshore access, setting new
benchmarks for safety, efficiency and reliability.

[

### Our services

][16]

## What we do

Increasing workability and uptime while reducing the costs of operations

### Heading

Motion compensation in six degrees of freedom maximises safety for personnel and cargo

### Heading

Providing an all-round service, from 24/7 support to operator training and data insights

### Heading

## Innovation

Continuous innovation is a core principle at Ampelmann. Our hexapod technology has revolutionised
the Walk to Work industry. In a constantly evolving energy market, we are always looking for new
ways to make offshore access as easy as crossing the street.

From electrifying our fleet and continuously looking for new ways to reduce our environmental
footprint, to engineering our systems with modularity in mind, we make sure to drive the industry
forward, while meeting the exact needs of our clients.

[Ampelmann A-type gangway connecting to a windmill.]

## Sustainability

Safety is a core value of our industry and company – and so is the safety of our environment.

In a world that is more interconnected than ever before, efficient and sustainable production of
energy is crucial. At Ampelmann, we believe that through continuous innovation, we can lead the
offshore access industry into a sustainable future.

[
Read more

#### How we can help you?

### [Shipbuilding][22]

The construction of a ship is a highly technical and complicated process. It involves the blending
of many skilled trades and contract employees working under the control of a primary contractor.
Shipbuilding is performed for both military and commercial purposes. It is an international
business, with major shipyards around the globe competing for a fairly limited amount of work.

### [Ship Repair & Conversion][23]

Ship repair generally includes all ship conversions, overhauls, maintenance programmes, major damage
repairs and minor equipment repairs. Ship repair is a very important part of the shipping and
shipbuilding industry.

### [Engineering][24]

Marine engineering is a branch of engineering that deals with the design, construction, operation,
and maintenance of ships, boats, and offshore structures. It is a multidisciplinary field that
combines elements of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronic engineering, and
computer science to address the specific challenges and requirements of marine environments.

#### Message from the CHAIRMAN

Dear Friends and Partners,

Located at the intersection of strategic transport corridors of the Caspian Sea, Baku Shipyard has a
unique infrastructure and a comprehensive workshop facilities capable of building commercial and
marine vessels. The shipyard has built oil and chemical tankers, road/rail passenger ferries, a
floating dock, a semi-submersible drilling rig and one and only multi-purpose subsea construction
vessel in the Caspian Sea – “Khankendi” with an enhanced DP3.

Inspired by the heritage, the advanced engineering and design team undertake activities in detail
design, production drawing, technical support, equipment test in accordance with the standards of
major classification societies such as DNV, ABS, Lloyds’s Register for Shipping, BV, RMRS and China
Classification Society. 

Competitive price, high construction speed and quality are the three main principles we focus on. We
adapt new construction methodologies, complex and integrative engineering applications, and the
latest advances in marine technology to our new and complex construction projects.

The safety of our employees and contractors is critical during the construction and repair of ships.
Accordingly, we not only comply the standards assigned but also improve the awareness of our
valuable staff constantly.

Elshad Nuriyev

Chairman of the Management of the Board

As a modern shipyard in the Caspian region, we are always striving to deliver top quality products
and provide the best services to all of our customers with:
* Implementing modern shipbuilding and repair technologies
* Designing & offering better solutions
* Committing to safety & quality
* Applying global best practice
* Continuously training and developing the staff
* Enhancing social and community initiatives
* Enacting energy and water efficiency
* Establishing strong supply chain relationships
* Following on waste management and recycling

#### How we can help you?

### [Shipbuilding][22]

The construction of a ship is a highly technical and complicated process. It involves the blending
of many skilled trades and contract employees working under the control of a primary contractor.
Shipbuilding is performed for both military and commercial purposes. It is an international
business, with major shipyards around the globe competing for a fairly limited amount of work.

### [Ship Repair & Conversion][23]

Ship repair generally includes all ship conversions, overhauls, maintenance programmes, major damage
repairs and minor equipment repairs. Ship repair is a very important part of the shipping and
shipbuilding industry.

### [Engineering][24]

Marine engineering is a branch of engineering that deals with the design, construction, operation,
and maintenance of ships, boats, and offshore structures. It is a multidisciplinary field that
combines elements of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronic engineering, and
computer science to address the specific challenges and requirements of marine environments.

#### Transit Time and Price Finder

# Transit Time Finder

The Transit Time Finder provides you with the delivery date for a selected service.

You are required to select the Blue Dart service required by you, the Origin and Destination City
and the pick up date and time below.

To confirm if the service required by you is available, for the origin and destination selected,
please check with our [Location Finder][45]. For detailed information on our services, refer to our
[Service Guide][46].

**NOTE 1 :** The scheduled delivery date given is subject to the Terms And Conditions Of Carriage,
details of which are available in our [Service Guide][47].

**NOTE 2 :** Some locations in or around the city could be out of delivery area and may require
extra time for delivery - [Contact Customer Service][48].

**NOTE 3 :** Transit Time arrived at are on best estimate basis and it is advisable to [Contact
Customer Service][49] for your definite shipping needs.

**NOTE 4 :** Non documents shipments are subject to stricter customs, excise, and/or regulatory
checks which may cause delays - please refer further to disclaimer section.

# Price Finder

The Price Finder helps you to calculate your shipping charges for your service type needs.

Charges will be based on the weight of the shipment in kgs or fractions thereof and may be
assessible either on the gross weight of the shipment or the volume/dimensional weight of the
shipment - whichever is higher.

The chargeable weight may be expressed as fractions of a kg. such as 0.25 kgs or 0.5 kgs and may go
upto 9999 kgs.

If you wish to contact our centralized customer service [click here][50].

[Portfolio Diversification: Why Putting All Your Eggs in One Basket Destroys Wealth][115]
By Cierra Seay
* Real diversification means spreading investments across all 11 economic sectors plus bonds,
  alternatives, and cash so no single bet can sink the portfolio.
* Different sectors perform at different times, so a diversified portfolio captures upswings while
  smoothing the brutal drawdowns that wipe out concentrated bets.
* Total market index funds offer the simplest path to diversification, and annual rebalancing is
  what keeps the structure working over time.
[Read More][116]
[
June 29, 2026
][117]
[Non Taxable Income: What It Is and Why It Matters][118]
By Milena Thomas
* Non taxable income is money you receive that you don't owe income tax on.
* The tax code treats workers, investors, and business owners very differently, and investors often
  come out ahead.
* Learning how income is taxed is a quiet superpower for keeping more of what you earn.
[Read More][119]
[
June 29, 2026
][120]
[Semiconductor Stocks: A Simple Guide for Investors][121]
By Nate Gregory
* Semiconductor stocks are companies that design and make computer chips, the brains inside nearly
  every modern device.
* The AI boom has turned chips into one of the market's most important and most watched groups.
* They offer big growth potential, but come with high valuations and a notoriously cyclical history.
[Read More][122]

June 25, 2026
][123]
[How Stocks Work: A Simple Guide for Beginners][124]
By Milena Thomas
* A stock is a slice of ownership in a company - buy one, and you own a piece of the business.
* You make money two ways: the share price rising over time, and dividends paid to shareholders.
* The simplest path for most beginners is buying into the whole market through a low-cost index
  fund.
[Read More][125]
[
June 25, 2026
][126]
[Stop Loss vs Stop Limit: What's the Difference?][127]
By Jackson Moreland
* A stop loss order sells your stock once it hits a trigger price, prioritizing getting you out.
* A stop limit order only sells within a price range you set, prioritizing price over a guaranteed
  exit.
* The trade-off: a stop loss almost always executes; a stop limit might not if the price moves too
  fast.
[Read More][128]
[
June 25, 2026
][129]
[Energy Stocks: A Simple Guide for Investors][130]
By Nate Gregory
* Energy stocks are companies that produce and supply the power the world runs on, from oil and gas
  to newer sources.
* They make up one of the 11 sectors of the market and tend to move with energy prices and
  big-picture shifts.
* Like any sector, the key is diversification and understanding the forces driving demand.
[Read More][131]
[
June 18, 2026
][132]
[What Is a Stop Loss Order? A Simple Guide][133]
By Nate Gregory
* A stop loss order automatically sells a stock once it falls to a price you set.
* It's a tool to cap losses or lock in gains without watching the market all day.
* It works best for active strategies, and can backfire if used carelessly on long-term holdings.
[Read More][134]
[

][135]
[Best S&P 500 Index Fund: How to Choose One][136]
By Kalbir Talwar
* The best S&P 500 index fund for most investors is simply the cheapest, most established one that
  tracks the index well.
* Funds like VOO, IVV, and SPY all hold the same 500 companies, so the biggest difference is the
  fee.
* Pick one, automate your buys, and let time do the heavy lifting.
[Read More][137]
[

][138]
[What Are Penny Stocks? Risks and Rewards Explained][139]
By Milena Thomas
* Penny stocks are very low-priced shares of very small companies, often trading for just a few
  dollars or less.
* They promise huge gains but carry huge risks: low liquidity, high failure rates, and wild price
  swings.
* Most investors are better served by quality companies and funds than by chasing cheap shares.
[Read More][140]

* The best stocks for beginners with little money usually aren't individual stocks at all - they're
  low-cost index funds.
* You can start with $100 or less and use small, regular investments to build wealth over time.
* Focus on diversification and consistency, not on picking the next big winner.

[Portfolio Diversification: Why Putting All Your Eggs in One Basket Destroys Wealth][115]
By Cierra Seay
* Real diversification means spreading investments across all 11 economic sectors plus bonds,
  alternatives, and cash so no single bet can sink the portfolio.
* Different sectors perform at different times, so a diversified portfolio captures upswings while
  smoothing the brutal drawdowns that wipe out concentrated bets.
* Total market index funds offer the simplest path to diversification, and annual rebalancing is
  what keeps the structure working over time.

[Non Taxable Income: What It Is and Why It Matters][118]
By Milena Thomas
* Non taxable income is money you receive that you don't owe income tax on.
* The tax code treats workers, investors, and business owners very differently, and investors often
  come out ahead.
* Learning how income is taxed is a quiet superpower for keeping more of what you earn.

][120]
[Semiconductor Stocks: A Simple Guide for Investors][121]
By Nate Gregory
* Semiconductor stocks are companies that design and make computer chips, the brains inside nearly
  every modern device.
* The AI boom has turned chips into one of the market's most important and most watched groups.
* They offer big growth potential, but come with high valuations and a notoriously cyclical history.

][123]
[How Stocks Work: A Simple Guide for Beginners][124]
By Milena Thomas
* A stock is a slice of ownership in a company - buy one, and you own a piece of the business.
* You make money two ways: the share price rising over time, and dividends paid to shareholders.
* The simplest path for most beginners is buying into the whole market through a low-cost index
  fund.
[Read More][125]

June 25, 2026
][126]
[Stop Loss vs Stop Limit: What's the Difference?][127]
By Jackson Moreland
* A stop loss order sells your stock once it hits a trigger price, prioritizing getting you out.
* A stop limit order only sells within a price range you set, prioritizing price over a guaranteed
  exit.
* The trade-off: a stop loss almost always executes; a stop limit might not if the price moves too
  fast.
[Read More][128]

By Nate Gregory
* Energy stocks are companies that produce and supply the power the world runs on, from oil and gas
  to newer sources.
* They make up one of the 11 sectors of the market and tend to move with energy prices and
  big-picture shifts.
* Like any sector, the key is diversification and understanding the forces driving demand.

[What Is a Stop Loss Order? A Simple Guide][133]
By Nate Gregory
* A stop loss order automatically sells a stock once it falls to a price you set.
* It's a tool to cap losses or lock in gains without watching the market all day.
* It works best for active strategies, and can backfire if used carelessly on long-term holdings.
[Read More][134]

[Best S&P 500 Index Fund: How to Choose One][136]

* The best S&P 500 index fund for most investors is simply the cheapest, most established one that
  tracks the index well.
* Funds like VOO, IVV, and SPY all hold the same 500 companies, so the biggest difference is the
  fee.
* Pick one, automate your buys, and let time do the heavy lifting.
[Read More][137]

[What Are Penny Stocks? Risks and Rewards Explained][139]
By Milena Thomas
* Penny stocks are very low-priced shares of very small companies, often trading for just a few
  dollars or less.
* They promise huge gains but carry huge risks: low liquidity, high failure rates, and wild price
  swings.
* Most investors are better served by quality companies and funds than by chasing cheap shares.

* Focus on diversification and consistency, not on picking the next big winner.

###### safer operations, higher availability and lower
###### operating costs through expert
###### ship management and global support.

### **HOW CAN WE HELP YOU?**

[

Keep your fleet performing at its best

#### Shipowners & Charterers

Reliable, transparent and compliant ship management solutions tailored to protect your assets,
optimise performance and deliver long-term value.

][14]
[

Develop your career at sea with confidence

#### Seafarers & Cadets

Join a global team committed to your safety, development and long-term career growth, at every stage
of your journey at sea.

][15]
[

Partner with a trusted global maritime leader

#### Partners

Delivering sustainable growth, operational excellence and long-term value through expertise,
innovation and strong industry partnerships.

][16]

##### **We combine expertise in ship, crew and performance
##### to deliver operational excellence.**

### **WHAT WE DO**

##### **Ship Management**

End-to-end vessel management delivering safety, reliability and operational excellence across your
fleet.

[Explore Full Ship Management ][17]

##### **Crew Management**

Global recruitment, training and development of highly qualified seafarers to ensure safe and
efficient operations.

[Discover Crew Solutions ][18]

##### **Vessel Performance & Decarbonisation**

Data-driven insights and operational expertise to optimise efficiency, reduce emissions and support
regulatory compliance.

[Improve Fleet Performance ][19]

##### **Crew Recruitment & Training**

Building a global pool of highly skilled seafarers through rigorous selection, training and
continuous development.

[Develop your Crew with Us ][20]

##### **Digital and Smart Shipping Solutions**

Advanced digital tools and connected systems to enhance vessel performance, transparency and
decision-making.

[Explore Digital Solutions ][21]

##### **Newbuilding, Conversion & Retrofit**

Expert project management from design to delivery, ensuring quality, efficiency and future-ready
vessels.

[View our Projects ][22]

##### **We deliver value through new vessels and
##### evolving fleet capabilities.**

### **PROVEN IN PRACTICE**

[

Successful delivery of a complex LNG drydocking

#### Milaha Qatar

The recent drydocking of LNG carrier Milaha Qatar, managed by BSM’s specialised LNG ship manager,
Pronav, was among the most demanding projects in ship management as LNG carrier dockings typically
require two years or more of preparation.

][23]
[

Management of first liquefied carbon dioxide (LCO₂) carrier

#### BSM enters LCO₂ carrier segment with management of “Northern Purpose”

BSM is taking over the management of its first liquefied carbon dioxide (LCO₂) carrier. The
innovative vessel was christened "Northern Purpose" on 19 May at Dalian Shipbuilding Offshore (DSOC)
in China.

][24]
[

Management of methanol dual-fuel bulk carrier

#### BSM Takes Delivery of First Methanol Dual-Fuel Bulk Carrier

BSM successfully took delivery of its first methanol dual-fuel bulk carrier M.V. Brave Pioneer on 15
January 2026 from Tuneshi Cebu Shipyard, demonstrating its operational preparedness for a multi-fuel
future.

][25]
[

Fleet portfolio expansion

#### Pronav welcomes first FSRU to its managed LNG fleet

BSM is expanding its fleet portfolio and has for the first time taken on the technical management of
a Floating Storage and Regasification Unit (FSRU). The vessel is managed by Pronav, BSM’s highly
specialised Ship Management Centre which exclusively operates large-scale LNG carriers from its
Hamburg-based office.

][26]

##### **We provide total fleet visibility, wherever your are.**

### **LIVEFLEET**
* One single source for all your data
* 24/7 transparency: Full visibility of your ﬂeet’s operations
* Accessible via your mobile and desktop
* Included in your ship management contract

[Explore More ][27]

Best for large, high-volume shipments that need a dedicated truck

# About CSS

For over a decade, CSS has consistently provided high quality field personnel to a wide range of
industries. With headquarters in Jersey and a global network of shore-based people spanning six
nations, we prioritise quality and client satisfaction in all we do.

We are dedicated to connecting talented individuals with their ideal roles within their chosen
industries. Through exceptional, responsive service, unwavering integrity, and a commitment to
understanding the needs of both candidates and clients, we consistently strive to innovate and
improve.

Dedicated to customer satisfaction, providing recruitment services that consistently meet and exceed
our clients' expectations.

Our dedication to sustainable growth is demonstrated by our active pursuit of innovative solutions
that minimize environmental impact and maximise efficiency.

We proactively prevent accidents and work-related ill-health, embedding HSE awareness into all
aspects of our business.

Our focus is on delivering consistently high-quality results and fostering a culture of continuous
improvement through proactive feedback

# Home

**Shipping Agency**
With over 25 years of experience and an impeccable record in the provision of transparent and
professional marine energy services, Divine Marine Shipping Ltd is at the forefront of the
Sub-Sahara Africa energy shipping industry and strategically positioned to represent both
established and new players in the energy markets of Nigeria and / or neighbouring oil producing
countries.

[[oil shipping agent]][18]Divine Marine Shipping Ltd (DMS ltd) is a dynamic shipping company which
is becoming a force to reckon with in the global shipping industry. Our strong emphasis on quality
of service means that we have a fast growing number of very satisfied customers. We render quality
and unparallel services to energy trading companies, oil marketing companies, blue-chip

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

Career

Are you looking to  leverage your existing knowledge and expertise to drive innovation? Or do you

### Data is the future’s DNA

We at Everllence therefore enable you to increase the efficiency, reliability and maintenance of
your products. By introducing our digital key products CEON and PrimeServ Assist, we created a
comprehensive digital ecosystem that allows us to collect, combine and evaluate relevant data. This
databased ecosystem is our digital backbone and the base for new digital customer centric solutions
of the future.

## Gain deep insights into our projects

Discover Story

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

[Learn more about our Focus][163]

Career

### Working at Everllence

Are you looking to  leverage your existing knowledge and expertise to drive innovation? Or do you
want to  start your career with a global leader  in engineering and technology? Are you ready to
make a lasting impact as part of our team at Everllence and move big things to zero with us?

Digitalization

### Data is the future’s DNA

We at Everllence therefore enable you to increase the efficiency, reliability and maintenance of
your products. By introducing our digital key products CEON and PrimeServ Assist, we created a
comprehensive digital ecosystem that allows us to collect, combine and evaluate relevant data. This
databased ecosystem is our digital backbone and the base for new digital customer centric solutions
of the future.

][173]

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

they were able to pull off a Rabat to Casa morning pickup at 10am when it was already between 1am
and 2am there for that day, and we were able to get our son on that flight, which looked like it was
the last one not cancelled. Thanks again ! Luc.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

# Strait of Hormuz Live Shipping Tracker

Real-time monitoring dashboard for the Strait of Hormuz crisis. The Strait of Hormuz was briefly
reopened on April 21, 2026, but closed again on April 22, 2026.

## Current Status

The strait is currently CLOSED. Commercial shipping suspended after brief reopening.

## Key Metrics
* Ships transiting: Near zero (normal: ~60/day)
* Stranded vessels: 150+ ships including tankers, bulk carriers, and other commercial vessels
* Oil prices: Brent crude surging due to supply disruption
* War risk insurance: Premiums at extreme levels, over 16x normal rates
* Throughput: Under 2% of normal daily deadweight tonnage

## Global Trade Impact

Approximately 21% of the world's oil supply and 25% of global LNG trade is at risk. Countries most
critically affected include South Korea and Japan, with high impact on India, China, and the
European Union. The estimated daily economic cost exceeds $4 billion.

## Supply Chain & Alternative Routes

Ships are rerouting via the Cape of Good Hope, adding up to 14 extra transit days and significantly
increasing shipping costs. Tanker spot rates have tripled for Gulf-to-Asia routes. The US Strategic
Petroleum Reserve provides a buffer, but prolonged disruption threatens global consumer prices.

## Crisis Timeline

Track key events in the Hormuz crisis including military escalations, diplomatic efforts, economic
impacts, and de-escalation attempts. Events are displayed chronologically with severity indicators.

## Peace Talks

Monitor the latest diplomatic developments and peace negotiations regarding the Strait of Hormuz
crisis.

## About This Dashboard

This dashboard provides real-time data on the Strait of Hormuz shipping crisis, including ship
transit counts, Brent crude oil prices, stranded vessel counts, war risk insurance premiums, daily
throughput, global trade impact analysis, crisis timeline, and peace talk status. Data is updated
hourly from multiple sources.

# Who we are

Klip Marine Shipmanagement Ltd. (KMS) is dedicated to providing top-notch ship management services
and is your trusted Partner for all your vessels' needs.

KMS was established in 1990, positioning itself as one of the pioneering privately owned shipping
and crew management companies in the Baltic States. Initially, the company operated under Baltic
Group International Shipping (BGI Shipping) and underwent a name change in 2003. An associated
office in Riga, Latvia, was established in 2011.

KMS has successfully navigated through all the economic waves and shipping cycles since 1990,
maintaining continuous growth while ensuring the safe and efficient operation of the managed fleet.

Over the past 30 years, KMS has managed a diverse range of vessels, including dry cargo and
chemical/oil product tankers, ranging from coasters to Capesize, totaling more than 80 different
vessels.

Today, KMS provides management services to a significant number of vessels flying various flags
engaged in global trade, ensuring safety and cost-effective operation.

The primary strength of KMS lies in its personnel, both ashore in its offices and aboard the managed
vessels. All our office staff possess a maritime background with experience gained at sea and/or
onshore in various shipping companies.

Core Activity

Our core activity is ship management on behalf of shipowners and financiers providing the following
services:
* Technical Ship
  Management
* Internal Audits
  (ISM, ISO, MLC and ISPS)
* Crew
  Management

  Registration

# Havalimanı'na Gitmek Çok Kolay !

Konforlu araçlarla, her gün gerçekleşen paylaşımlı transferlerimiz ile Kuşadası'ndan İzmir
Havalimanı'na ulaşımınızı uygun fiyatlarla kolayca sağlayabilirsiniz.

###### Ekonomik ve Konforlu

Paylaşımlı transfer hizmetimiz ile ekonomik ve konforlu yolculuğun tadını çıkarın..

###### Güvenilir ve Deneyimli

Profesyonel ve deneyimli ekibimiz ile kusursuz bir transfer deneyimi yaşayın.

###### 100000+ Memnun Müşteri

Memnuniyetiniz için elimizden gelen bütün çabayı sarf ediyoruz.
[İzmir Havalimanı - Kuşadası Transfer]

### KUŞADASI - İZMİR HAVALİMANI PAYLAŞIMLI TRANSFER

Her gün gerçekleşen Kuşadası - İzmir Adnan Menderes Havalimanı - Kuşadası paylaşımlı transferlerimiz
ile havaalanı ulaşımınızı kişi başı sadece 500 TL'na kolayca sağlayabilirsiniz.

##### İzmir Havaalanı Seyahatlerinizde Her Zaman Yanınızdayız

İster özel havaalanı transfer hizmetimiz ile ayrıcalıklı yolculuğun tadını çıkarın, isterseniz
paylaşımlı transfer hizmetimiz ile ekonomik bir yolculuk sağlayın. Her koşulda size en iyi transfer
hizmetini yaşatmak için elimizden gelen bütün çabayı sarf ettiğimizden emin olabilirsiniz.

##### Kuşadası -İzmir Paylaşımlı Transfer Hakkında

Transfer hizmetimizden uçak biletiniz hangi havayolundan(Sunexpress, Corendon, Türk Hava Yolları,
Anadolu Jet, Pegasus) olursa olsun faydalanabilirsiniz.

Kuşadası - İzmir Adnan Menderes Havalimanı yaklaşık 1 Saat 15 Dakika sürmektedir, transfer saatinizi
seçerken bu duruma dikkat ediniz.

Transfer hizmetimizden en sağlıklı şekilde yararlanmak için lütfen önceden rezervasyon yaptırınız.
Rezervasyon için** 0256 614 55 55** numaralı telefonu arayabilirsiniz.Daha fazla bilgi için
[**Önemli Bilgiler**][18] sayfamızı ziyaret edebilirsiniz.

### HİZMETLERİMİZ

Ulaşım konusunda ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz çeşitli hizmetlerimiz ile keyifli yolculuğun tadını çıkarın
!

[
[Paylaşımlı Transfer]

##### Kuşadası - İzmir Paylaşımlı Transfer

Paylaşımlı transfer hizmetinin amacı, sizinle aynı saatte uçuş yapacak olan yolcuları bir araya
getirerek ekonomik bir ulaşım sağlamaktır.
][19]
[
[kuşadası vip transfer]

##### Vip Transfer

Sadece size özel tahsis edilen araçlarla, yolculuğunuzun kurallarını siz belirleyin ve keyfini
çıkarın.
][20]
[
[Kongre & Seminer Taşımacılığı]

##### Kongre & Seminer Taşımacılığı

Düzenleyeceğiniz Kongre ve Seminer organizasyonlarınızda ulaşım ihtiyaçlarınız için profesyonel
çözümler sunuyoruz.
][21]

### NEDEN BİZİ TERCİH ETMELİSİNİZ ?

Bizi tercih etmeniz için gerekli birçok nedenden sadece birkaçı...

#### Deneyimli Ekip

Last Minute Turizm 30 yıllık tecrübesiyle, turizm ve ulaşım konusunda tecrübeli ekibi ile kusursuz
bir deneyim sunar.

#### Müşteri Memnuniyeti

Müşteri memnuniyetine önem veriyoruz çünkü, bizim için öncelikli olan müşterilerimize sunduğumuz
deneyimin kalitesini her geçen gün arttırmak.

#### Ekonomik ve Konforlu Ulaşım

Kuşadası - İzmir havalimanı paylaşımlı transfer hizmetimizle ekonomi ve konforu bir arada sunuyoruz.

### MÜŞTERİ yorumlarI

Değerli müşterilermizin yorumlarından bazıları...

[Man]

#### Seher Ö.

###### Türkiye

Sistemli ve profesyonel çalışmanızı çok beğendim, ilkeli bir şirketten bekleyeceğim şekilde hizmet
aldım, çalışanlarınız son derece kibar ve ilgili, bundan sonraki uçuşlarımda sizi tercih edeceğim ve
herkese öneriyorum teşekkürler..

[Man]

###### Türkiye

Size kaç yıldız versem az olur. Son yurtdışı yolculuğumda havalimanına gidiş dönüş problem
yaşamadım.Hepinize çok teşekkür ediyorum.Tekrar görüşeceğiz...

[Man]

###### 100000+ Memnun Müşteri

Memnuniyetiniz için elimizden gelen bütün çabayı sarf ediyoruz.
[İzmir Havalimanı - Kuşadası Transfer]

### KUŞADASI - İZMİR HAVALİMANI PAYLAŞIMLI TRANSFER

Her gün gerçekleşen Kuşadası - İzmir Adnan Menderes Havalimanı - Kuşadası paylaşımlı transferlerimiz
ile havaalanı ulaşımınızı kişi başı sadece 500 TL'na kolayca sağlayabilirsiniz.

##### İzmir Havaalanı Seyahatlerinizde Her Zaman Yanınızdayız

İster özel havaalanı transfer hizmetimiz ile ayrıcalıklı yolculuğun tadını çıkarın, isterseniz
paylaşımlı transfer hizmetimiz ile ekonomik bir yolculuk sağlayın. Her koşulda size en iyi transfer
hizmetini yaşatmak için elimizden gelen bütün çabayı sarf ettiğimizden emin olabilirsiniz.

##### Kuşadası -İzmir Paylaşımlı Transfer Hakkında

Transfer hizmetimizden uçak biletiniz hangi havayolundan(Sunexpress, Corendon, Türk Hava Yolları,
Anadolu Jet, Pegasus) olursa olsun faydalanabilirsiniz.

Kuşadası - İzmir Adnan Menderes Havalimanı yaklaşık 1 Saat 15 Dakika sürmektedir, transfer saatinizi
seçerken bu duruma dikkat ediniz.

Transfer hizmetimizden en sağlıklı şekilde yararlanmak için lütfen önceden rezervasyon yaptırınız.
Rezervasyon için** 0256 614 55 55** numaralı telefonu arayabilirsiniz.Daha fazla bilgi için
[**Önemli Bilgiler**][18] sayfamızı ziyaret edebilirsiniz.

### HİZMETLERİMİZ

Ulaşım konusunda ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz çeşitli hizmetlerimiz ile keyifli yolculuğun tadını çıkarın
!

[
[Paylaşımlı Transfer]

##### Kuşadası - İzmir Paylaşımlı Transfer

Paylaşımlı transfer hizmetinin amacı, sizinle aynı saatte uçuş yapacak olan yolcuları bir araya
getirerek ekonomik bir ulaşım sağlamaktır.
][19]
[
[kuşadası vip transfer]

##### Vip Transfer

Sadece size özel tahsis edilen araçlarla, yolculuğunuzun kurallarını siz belirleyin ve keyfini
çıkarın.
][20]
[
[Kongre & Seminer Taşımacılığı]

Düzenleyeceğiniz Kongre ve Seminer organizasyonlarınızda ulaşım ihtiyaçlarınız için profesyonel
çözümler sunuyoruz.
][21]

#### Deneyimli Ekip

bir deneyim sunar.

Müşteri memnuniyetine önem veriyoruz çünkü, bizim için öncelikli olan müşterilerimize sunduğumuz

#### Ekonomik ve Konforlu Ulaşım

Mariner Ship’s Equipment has accumulated years of experience in the design of different types of
hatch covers, ro-ro equipments, deck winches, cranes, rudders, steering gears and other deck
equipments.

# Product

Mariner’s main production facility is located in Tuzla, Istanbul; at the heart of Turkey’s
shipbuilding industry. The mild temperatures of the region provide a suitable environment for year
round production.

# Service

Mariner provides global service and support for all its products. Our service engineers are located
both in Istanbul, Turkey and in Hamburg, Germany.

  ## ABOUT US
  
  MMC Ports is Malaysia’s largest port operating group and is a wholly owned subsidiary of MMC
  Corporation Berhad. MMC Ports is a holding company for its subsidiaries that operate ports across
  Peninsular Malaysia, namely Port of Tanjung Pelepas and Johor Port in Johor, Northport in
  Selangor, Penang Port in Penang, Tanjung Bruas Port in Melaka and Andaman Port in Kedah.
  
  The business of MMC Ports and its subsidiaries also includes a solid product jetty terminal in
  Johor, ship-to-ship transfer services in Port of Yan in Kedah, and cruise terminals in Penang,
  Port Klang and Langkawi. **MMC Ports is a member of MMC Corporation Berhad. Click **[here][7]

# oceane group

Oceane Group, founded in 2021, has rapidly expanded its ship-to-ship (STS) transfer operations,
offering comprehensive solutions for the maritime and energy sectors.
The company specializes in transferring various types of cargo, including crude oil, refined
petroleum products, LPG, LNG, Biofuel and Bulk liquid chemicals, both offshore and within port
limits.

Backed by 35 years of management expertise, we deliver flawless, efficient, and highly professional
logistics for the Ship-to-Ship industry.

### Seamless & Safe STS Operations

Our highly experienced Mooring Masters oversee every operation, ensuring seamless execution while
strictly adhering to our audited procedures and policies.

### Personalized Support, Anytime

Our dedicated operations team is available 24/7 to support you through every stage of your
Ship-to-Ship (STS) operation—from pre-arrival planning and documentation to real-time coordination
and post-operation reporting.

### Top-Tier STS Equipment

Our STS equipment is handled, stored, and maintained with precision, following strict manufacturer
guidelines. Regular testing, servicing, and ISO-certified inspections ensure optimal performance and
safety for every transfer.

# oceane group

Oceane Group, founded in 2021, has rapidly expanded its ship-to-ship (STS) transfer operations,
offering comprehensive solutions for the maritime and energy sectors.
The company specializes in transferring various types of cargo, including crude oil, refined
petroleum products, LPG, LNG, Biofuel and Bulk liquid chemicals, both offshore and within port
limits.

Backed by 35 years of management expertise, we deliver flawless, efficient, and highly professional
logistics for the Ship-to-Ship industry.

### Seamless & Safe STS Operations

Our highly experienced Mooring Masters oversee every operation, ensuring seamless execution while
strictly adhering to our audited procedures and policies.

### Personalized Support, Anytime

Our dedicated operations team is available 24/7 to support you through every stage of your
Ship-to-Ship (STS) operation—from pre-arrival planning and documentation to real-time coordination
and post-operation reporting.

### Top-Tier STS Equipment

Our STS equipment is handled, stored, and maintained with precision, following strict manufacturer
guidelines. Regular testing, servicing, and ISO-certified inspections ensure optimal performance and
safety for every transfer.

## Safe with us

Since its establishment in 1921, Oldendorff Carriers has grown into one of the world’s leading dry
bulk owners and operators. Today we celebrate 105 years of one-stop shipping, assuring the service
quality and responsiveness that your bulk transportation needs.

## Oldendorff at a Glance

Each year, we carry about 415 million tons of bulk and unitised cargo around the world. We perform
15,000 port calls in 127 countries. On average, we operate about 780 chartered and owned ships at
any one time.

## Our story

From our roots as a small German shipowner we have grown into one of the world’s leading dry bulk
operators. With 4,500 employees from 60 countries, 20 offices and 8 transshipment projects, we can
cater for your bulk transportation needs.

Family ownership gives us an edge over many of our competitors, who have a more anonymous
shareholding structure. Profits are not paid out as dividends, but retained for future investments,
so we can pursue a long-term counter-cyclical strategy. As a specialist in spot business, industrial
contracts and offshore transshipment, we focus fully on drybulk logistics.

Our transshipment solutions enable clients to use bigger ships on long haul routes, resulting in
freight savings. We transship iron ore for steel clients in the Arabian Gulf, coal for power
stations in Türkiye, Bangladesh and Northern Vietnam, bauxite from Kamsar, Guinea and coal and other
commodities at our transshipment hubs in Trinidad and Southern Vietnam.

Our dedicated people and financial standing enable us to assure the quality of service and the fast
and flexible responsiveness that our clients have come to expect from us. Your cargo and your
business are safe with us.

[Beate Oldendorff Sea trial 09 Mar 20 1]
[Jens O Jonas O by Captain Eduard Mateyko May 23]

## Solid Performance

OLDENDORFF CARRIERS continues to deliver positive financial results and excellent operational
performance. Having a strong financial position and low leverage – with long debt maturities and
fixed interest rates – puts us on a sound financial footing. Our current investment program of
approximately US$ 4 billion in environmentally friendly vessels is funded primarily from operational
cashflow.

Our significant net worth gives confidence to our clients, who entrust us with long-term industrial
CoA’s and repeat spot business. Throughout our 105 year history, we have performed 100% of our
contracts, charters and financial obligations. We will never let you down.

## Safe with us

Since its establishment in 1921, Oldendorff Carriers has grown into one of the world’s leading dry
bulk owners and operators. Today we celebrate 105 years of one-stop shipping, assuring the service
quality and responsiveness that your bulk transportation needs.

## Oldendorff at a Glance

Each year, we carry about 415 million tons of bulk and unitised cargo around the world. We perform
15,000 port calls in 127 countries. On average, we operate about 780 chartered and owned ships at
any one time.

## Our story

From our roots as a small German shipowner we have grown into one of the world’s leading dry bulk
operators. With 4,500 employees from 60 countries, 20 offices and 8 transshipment projects, we can
cater for your bulk transportation needs.

Family ownership gives us an edge over many of our competitors, who have a more anonymous
shareholding structure. Profits are not paid out as dividends, but retained for future investments,
so we can pursue a long-term counter-cyclical strategy. As a specialist in spot business, industrial
contracts and offshore transshipment, we focus fully on drybulk logistics.

Our transshipment solutions enable clients to use bigger ships on long haul routes, resulting in
freight savings. We transship iron ore for steel clients in the Arabian Gulf, coal for power
stations in Türkiye, Bangladesh and Northern Vietnam, bauxite from Kamsar, Guinea and coal and other
commodities at our transshipment hubs in Trinidad and Southern Vietnam.

Our dedicated people and financial standing enable us to assure the quality of service and the fast
and flexible responsiveness that our clients have come to expect from us. Your cargo and your
business are safe with us.

## Solid Performance

OLDENDORFF CARRIERS continues to deliver positive financial results and excellent operational
performance. Having a strong financial position and low leverage – with long debt maturities and
fixed interest rates – puts us on a sound financial footing. Our current investment program of
approximately US$ 4 billion in environmentally friendly vessels is funded primarily from operational
cashflow.

Our significant net worth gives confidence to our clients, who entrust us with long-term industrial
CoA’s and repeat spot business. Throughout our 105 year history, we have performed 100% of our
contracts, charters and financial obligations. We will never let you down.

## International tracking tips

Everything you need to know

Find out how to locate your shipment in one click regardless of the carrier.

Frequently asked questions

### How to track a package?

[How to track a package?]

Ordertracker offers a simple and convenient way to **track your packages** and shipments from around
the world.** To begin, you'll need the tracking number** provided by the sender or shipping company.

Click this link and enter your tracking number. After inputting the number, press "enter", and our
package tracker will retrieve the latest tracking updates for your package.

It will then **display a comprehensive timeline of your package's journey**, including information
about its current location, transit history, and expected delivery date. This allows you to stay
informed about the whereabouts of your package in real-time, ensuring you're always in the know
about its status.

### Where do I find my tracking number?

[How to track a package?]

Finding your tracking number is usually straightforward. When you make a purchase online or send a
package, **the tracking number is provided by the shipping carrier or the sender**. If you're the
recipient of a package, the sender will typically share the tracking number with you either through
an email, a text message, or on the order confirmation page.

For online purchases, you can often locate the tracking number by logging into your account **on the
retailer's website** and checking your order history or tracking section. Additionally, if you've
received a shipping notification, the tracking number is often included in that email or message.

Once you have the tracking number in hand, you can easily use it to monitor the progress of your
package Ordertracker, and gain insights into its journey and estimated delivery date.

### Why isn't my package moving in the package tracking history?

[How to track a package?]

Encountering a situation where your package appears to be stuck can be frustrating, but there are
steps you can take to address the issue. If you've been tracking your package using Ordertracker and
notice that it hasn't progressed in a while, the first step is to **remain patient**. Sometimes
**delays can occur due to various factors** like customs processing or temporary logistic issues.

However, if you believe there might be an issue, the next course of action is to **contact the
shipping carrier or the sender**. They will have more specific information about the package's
current status and might be able to provide insights or initiate inquiries on your behalf.

Be sure to have your tracking number handy when reaching out to expedite the process. In some cases,
packages are misrouted or held up due to address issues, so verifying the address details you
provided is also a good step. Remember that **shipping delays, while frustrating, can often be
resolved with the assistance of the carrier** or sender's customer service.

### When I track my package, why does it show as "returned"?

[How to track a package?]

When you track your package and it shows as "returned," it typically indicates that the package has
been sent back to the sender or the originating location for some reason. There are a few common
reasons why a package might be marked as "returned":
* **Incorrect address:** If the delivery address provided by the sender or the recipient was
  inaccurate, incomplete, or unclear, the carrier might have been unable to deliver the package and
  chose to return it to the sender.
* **Failed delivery attempts:** If the carrier attempted to deliver the package multiple times but
  was unsuccessful, they might opt to return the package to the sender rather than holding it
  indefinitely.
* **Unclaimed package:** If the recipient does not pick up the package from a local post office or
  delivery center within a certain timeframe, the carrier might return the package to the sender.
* **Customs issues:** For international shipments, packages can be returned due to customs clearance
  issues, such as missing or incorrect documentation.

If you see your package marked as "returned" in the tracking information, it's advisable to
**contact the sender or the carrier's customer service** to understand the specific reason for the
return and to discuss potential solutions, such as reshipment or refund. Keep in mind that the
return process can vary depending on the carrier and the circumstances surrounding the package's
return.

### Why does the parcel tracking timeline indicate that my order cannot be found?

[How to track a package?]

If the parcel tracking timeline indicates that your order cannot be found, there could be a few
reasons why:
* **Incorrect tracking number:** Double-check the tracking number you've entered to make sure it's
  accurate. Even a small typo or error in the tracking number can lead to the system not recognizing
  your package.
* **Delayed update:** Sometimes, there might be a delay in updating the tracking information in the
  system. Give it some time and try again later to see if the tracking details are updated.
* **Recently shipped:** If the package was recently shipped, it might not have been processed by the
  carrier's system yet. Tracking information might become available once the carrier scans and
  processes the package.

If you're sure that you've entered the correct tracking number and still can't find any tracking
information, **consider reaching out to the sender or the carrier's customer service**. They might
be able to provide more information or help you troubleshoot the issue.

### Can I track a parcel sent from China?

[How to track a package?]

Absolutely, **you can track a parcel sent from China** using Ordertracker. When you have the
tracking number provided by the sender or the shipping carrier, you can **enter it into the tracking
search bar on this section.** Ordertracker will then retrieve the tracking information for your
parcel and display its route from China to its destination.

China is a major hub for international shipping, and many carriers provide tracking services for
packages originating from China and **most Chinese carriers are supported** by Ordertracker.

Keep in mind that the accuracy and availability of **tracking information can depend on the
carrier** handling the package and the level of detail they provide. If you have any concerns or
questions about your tracked package sent from China, you can also contact the shipping carrier's
customer service for assistance.

### Why should I use Ordertracker instead of the official post office tracking?

[How to track a package?]

Using Ordertracker as an alternative to the official post office tracking system offers certain
advantages. While both options serve the purpose of tracking your packages, there are reasons you
might consider using Ordertracker:
* **Centralized tracking:** Our order tracking app provides a centralized platform that supports
  tracking for multiple carriers and shipping companies worldwide. This can be especially helpful if
  you're tracking packages from different carriers or across various countries, as you can access
  all tracking information in one place.
* **Consolidated updates:** With Ordertracker, you can receive consolidated tracking updates
  regardless of the carrier. This can save you time and effort compared to manually visiting
  multiple carrier websites to track different packages.
* **Global coverage:** If you're dealing with international shipments, Ordertracker's wide range of
  supported carriers can be especially valuable, as it allows you to track packages across various
  borders and regions.
* **Additional information:** Ordertracker provides additional information about the tracking
  process, such as estimated delivery times and explanations of tracking statuses.

While the official post office tracking system might be the go-to choice for domestic shipments
handled by the respective postal service, using **Ordertracker can be advantageous when dealing with
multiple carriers**, international shipments, or when you prefer a more consolidated and
user-friendly tracking experience. It's important to note that your choice between the two options
might also depend on the specific carriers and shipping methods you're using.

## International tracking tips

Everything you need to know

Find out how to locate your shipment in one click regardless of the carrier.

Frequently asked questions

### How to track a package?

[How to track a package?]

Ordertracker offers a simple and convenient way to **track your packages** and shipments from around
the world.** To begin, you'll need the tracking number** provided by the sender or shipping company.

Click this link and enter your tracking number. After inputting the number, press "enter", and our
package tracker will retrieve the latest tracking updates for your package.

It will then **display a comprehensive timeline of your package's journey**, including information
about its current location, transit history, and expected delivery date. This allows you to stay
informed about the whereabouts of your package in real-time, ensuring you're always in the know
about its status.

### Where do I find my tracking number?

[How to track a package?]

Finding your tracking number is usually straightforward. When you make a purchase online or send a
package, **the tracking number is provided by the shipping carrier or the sender**. If you're the
recipient of a package, the sender will typically share the tracking number with you either through
an email, a text message, or on the order confirmation page.

For online purchases, you can often locate the tracking number by logging into your account **on the
retailer's website** and checking your order history or tracking section. Additionally, if you've
received a shipping notification, the tracking number is often included in that email or message.

Once you have the tracking number in hand, you can easily use it to monitor the progress of your
package Ordertracker, and gain insights into its journey and estimated delivery date.

### Why isn't my package moving in the package tracking history?

[How to track a package?]

Encountering a situation where your package appears to be stuck can be frustrating, but there are
steps you can take to address the issue. If you've been tracking your package using Ordertracker and
notice that it hasn't progressed in a while, the first step is to **remain patient**. Sometimes
**delays can occur due to various factors** like customs processing or temporary logistic issues.

However, if you believe there might be an issue, the next course of action is to **contact the
shipping carrier or the sender**. They will have more specific information about the package's
current status and might be able to provide insights or initiate inquiries on your behalf.

Be sure to have your tracking number handy when reaching out to expedite the process. In some cases,
packages are misrouted or held up due to address issues, so verifying the address details you
provided is also a good step. Remember that **shipping delays, while frustrating, can often be
resolved with the assistance of the carrier** or sender's customer service.

### When I track my package, why does it show as "returned"?

[How to track a package?]

When you track your package and it shows as "returned," it typically indicates that the package has
been sent back to the sender or the originating location for some reason. There are a few common
reasons why a package might be marked as "returned":
* **Incorrect address:** If the delivery address provided by the sender or the recipient was
  inaccurate, incomplete, or unclear, the carrier might have been unable to deliver the package and
  chose to return it to the sender.
* **Failed delivery attempts:** If the carrier attempted to deliver the package multiple times but
  was unsuccessful, they might opt to return the package to the sender rather than holding it
  indefinitely.
* **Unclaimed package:** If the recipient does not pick up the package from a local post office or
  delivery center within a certain timeframe, the carrier might return the package to the sender.
* **Customs issues:** For international shipments, packages can be returned due to customs clearance
  issues, such as missing or incorrect documentation.

If you see your package marked as "returned" in the tracking information, it's advisable to
**contact the sender or the carrier's customer service** to understand the specific reason for the
return and to discuss potential solutions, such as reshipment or refund. Keep in mind that the
return process can vary depending on the carrier and the circumstances surrounding the package's
return.

### Why does the parcel tracking timeline indicate that my order cannot be found?

[How to track a package?]

If the parcel tracking timeline indicates that your order cannot be found, there could be a few
reasons why:
* **Incorrect tracking number:** Double-check the tracking number you've entered to make sure it's
  accurate. Even a small typo or error in the tracking number can lead to the system not recognizing
  your package.
* **Delayed update:** Sometimes, there might be a delay in updating the tracking information in the
  system. Give it some time and try again later to see if the tracking details are updated.
* **Recently shipped:** If the package was recently shipped, it might not have been processed by the
  carrier's system yet. Tracking information might become available once the carrier scans and
  processes the package.

If you're sure that you've entered the correct tracking number and still can't find any tracking
information, **consider reaching out to the sender or the carrier's customer service**. They might
be able to provide more information or help you troubleshoot the issue.

### Can I track a parcel sent from China?

[How to track a package?]

Absolutely, **you can track a parcel sent from China** using Ordertracker. When you have the
tracking number provided by the sender or the shipping carrier, you can **enter it into the tracking
search bar on this section.** Ordertracker will then retrieve the tracking information for your
parcel and display its route from China to its destination.

China is a major hub for international shipping, and many carriers provide tracking services for
packages originating from China and **most Chinese carriers are supported** by Ordertracker.

Keep in mind that the accuracy and availability of **tracking information can depend on the
carrier** handling the package and the level of detail they provide. If you have any concerns or
questions about your tracked package sent from China, you can also contact the shipping carrier's
customer service for assistance.

### Why should I use Ordertracker instead of the official post office tracking?

[How to track a package?]

Using Ordertracker as an alternative to the official post office tracking system offers certain
advantages. While both options serve the purpose of tracking your packages, there are reasons you
might consider using Ordertracker:
* **Centralized tracking:** Our order tracking app provides a centralized platform that supports
  tracking for multiple carriers and shipping companies worldwide. This can be especially helpful if
  you're tracking packages from different carriers or across various countries, as you can access
  all tracking information in one place.
* **Consolidated updates:** With Ordertracker, you can receive consolidated tracking updates
  regardless of the carrier. This can save you time and effort compared to manually visiting
  multiple carrier websites to track different packages.
* **Global coverage:** If you're dealing with international shipments, Ordertracker's wide range of
  supported carriers can be especially valuable, as it allows you to track packages across various
  borders and regions.
* **Additional information:** Ordertracker provides additional information about the tracking
  process, such as estimated delivery times and explanations of tracking statuses.

While the official post office tracking system might be the go-to choice for domestic shipments
handled by the respective postal service, using **Ordertracker can be advantageous when dealing with
multiple carriers**, international shipments, or when you prefer a more consolidated and
user-friendly tracking experience. It's important to note that your choice between the two options
might also depend on the specific carriers and shipping methods you're using.

### OVER 180 YEARS OF MARINE HERITAGE

P&O Maritime Logistics is a world leader in marine solutions focused on offshore energy, port
services and cargo transport. As a solutions-focused partner in the DP World family, we provide
customized marine services to connect remote resources to the world markets.

[OUR SERVICES][31]

[Modern and versatile fleet]

### REDEFINING PROJECT CARGO TRANSPORTATION

From inland waterways to offshore wind farms, our flexible and adaptable Module Carrying Vessels
(MCVs) deliver safe, sustainable, and tailored transport solutions for heavy modules and complex
cargo.

Shallow draft. Heavy-lift capability. Exceptional maneuverability. We operate where others cannot.

Wherever your project takes you, we are ready.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR MCV FLEET][32]

### RELIABLE OFFSHORE SUPPORT FOR COMPLEX ENERGY OPERATIONS

We provide end-to-end offshore support vessel (OSV) services and integrated marine logistics to the
global energy industry, supporting complex offshore operations worldwide.

With a modern OSV fleet, highly experienced crews, and strong logistics capability, we deliver safe,
reliable, and efficient offshore support from installation to decommissioning — ensuring operational
continuity across demanding and dynamic maritime environments.

[LEARN MORE][33]

[Our Business Model]

### SEAMLESS PORT OPERATIONS & TRUSTED BULK LOGISTICS

Integrated port operations and bulk logistics that keep global trade moving.

From safe vessel arrival and departure to the transport of minerals, grains, and cement, we connect
complex supply chains through efficient marine and inland solutions.

[EXPLORE OUR CAPABILITIES][34]

### CAREERS

Our people are the driving force behind our global success. From terminal controllers and operations
managers to vessel captains and technical specialists – every role plays a critical part in our
success.

With a geographically diverse workforce, spanning seven continents, we hire and train local talent –
utilizing local resources to strengthen the communities where we operate.

[JOIN US][35]

### SAFETY FIRST ALWAYS

Health, safety and environmental responsibility are at the heart of all that we do.

We hold ourselves – and our partners – to the highest standards.

Safe operations. Sustainable practices. Zero compromise.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR COMMITMENT][36]

##### P&O

P&O Maritime Logistics is a leading provider of marine solutions with focus on offshore energy, port

### OVER 180 YEARS OF MARINE HERITAGE

P&O Maritime Logistics is a world leader in marine solutions focused on offshore energy, port
services and cargo transport. As a solutions-focused partner in the DP World family, we provide
customized marine services to connect remote resources to the world markets.

[OUR SERVICES][31]

[Modern and versatile fleet]

### REDEFINING PROJECT CARGO TRANSPORTATION

From inland waterways to offshore wind farms, our flexible and adaptable Module Carrying Vessels
(MCVs) deliver safe, sustainable, and tailored transport solutions for heavy modules and complex
cargo.

Shallow draft. Heavy-lift capability. Exceptional maneuverability. We operate where others cannot.

Wherever your project takes you, we are ready.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR MCV FLEET][32]

### RELIABLE OFFSHORE SUPPORT FOR COMPLEX ENERGY OPERATIONS

We provide end-to-end offshore support vessel (OSV) services and integrated marine logistics to the
global energy industry, supporting complex offshore operations worldwide.

With a modern OSV fleet, highly experienced crews, and strong logistics capability, we deliver safe,
reliable, and efficient offshore support from installation to decommissioning — ensuring operational
continuity across demanding and dynamic maritime environments.

[LEARN MORE][33]

[Our Business Model]

### SEAMLESS PORT OPERATIONS & TRUSTED BULK LOGISTICS

Integrated port operations and bulk logistics that keep global trade moving.

From safe vessel arrival and departure to the transport of minerals, grains, and cement, we connect
complex supply chains through efficient marine and inland solutions.

[EXPLORE OUR CAPABILITIES][34]

### CAREERS

Our people are the driving force behind our global success. From terminal controllers and operations
managers to vessel captains and technical specialists – every role plays a critical part in our
success.

With a geographically diverse workforce, spanning seven continents, we hire and train local talent –
utilizing local resources to strengthen the communities where we operate.

[JOIN US][35]

### SAFETY FIRST ALWAYS

Health, safety and environmental responsibility are at the heart of all that we do.

We hold ourselves – and our partners – to the highest standards.

Safe operations. Sustainable practices. Zero compromise.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR COMMITMENT][36]

More than 3000 employees in over 35 countries

Quality and expertise, forward-looking technologies, proximity and personal commitment: that is both
our mission statement and a customer promise. This approach is the result of our experiences as an
independent, family-run logistics service provider since 1852. We offer a long term partnership,
with a clear customer-focused approach. That is how we inspire the trust of our partners.

Stronger together – your career at Röhlig

Get started! Whether you're a career starter or an experienced professional, discover exciting tasks
in an international environment. We value international and collegial cooperation. Our team of
logistics experts, IT specialists, and innovative minds is constantly growing – become a part of it!

logistics. Founded in 1852 in Bremen, Germany, the family-owned company stands for trusted
partnerships and long-term expertise. Today, over 2,800 staff members in more than 35 countries
deliver tailor-made solutions and high-quality services to customers worldwide.

###### INVENTORS OF THE MODERN SHIPLIFT

## THE LEGACY CONTINUES

[ABOUT US][32]
[search-icon]

##### OUR STORY

## 65+ Years Building Shiplifts

In 1957, Raymond Pearlson invented, patented and built the first shiplift, which he called
"Syncrolift". Over the following 65+ years, his invention has transformed the capabilities of
shipyards worldwide. Today, Pearlson Shiplift Corporation continues that legacy into the
twenty-first century with the most experienced team of shiplift engineers and technical support
specialists in the world.

[LEARN MORE][33]
[search-icon]

##### products

## Shiplift & Transfer Systems

Pearlson Shiplift Corporation specializes in the design, manufacture, servicing and ongoing support
of new and existing shiplifts and transfer systems. Our team has had experience designing and
supporting shiplifts and ship transfer systems worldwide for over 65 years.

[LEARN MORE][34]
[search-icon]

##### Installations

## Installations in Over 60 Countries

With recent orders for twelve (12) new shiplift systems, including four (4) facilities to support
the Superyacht Repair and Refit Industry, as well as two (2) of the Largest Shiplift Systems in both
North & South America in support of the U.S. Navy, Pearlson Shiplift Corporation continues its
legacy as the premier choice for shipyards all around the World.

[LEARN MORE][35]

#### #1Supplier

We are the sole provider of OEM Spare Parts, made in the USA

#### 6Decades

Our team has more than 65+ years of experience in Shiplift Systems

#### 70+Countries

We have installations in over 70+ countries around the world.

#### 200+Installations

We service and support more than 250+ installations around the world.

## How It Works Videos

We are the only company in the world that is devoted exclusively to the design, manufacture and
support of shiplift and transfer systems.

### Savannah Yacht Center

###### Savannah Yacht Center is a premier deep-water superyacht maintenance, repair and refit
###### facility dedicated to servicing the yacht industry.

Play

### Abeking & Rasmussen

###### Established in 1907, Abeking & Rasmussen, located in Lemwerder, Germany, is responsible for
###### building some of the World’s finest vessels. From Award Winning Superyachts, to Naval
###### Vessels, to Research Ships, there is nothing the team from A&R can’t do. 

Play

### Marina Barcelona 92

###### MB92 Superyacht Refit offers professional superyacht refit after sales, service and repair
###### worldwide, with more than 25 years of unrivaled experience. MB92 offers customers two (2)
###### shiplift systems supported by Pearlson Shiplift Corporation.

Play

### VARD Tulcea

###### Established in 1975, VARD Tulcea is one of the premier shipbuilding yards in the World,
###### offering a strategic location to enable the shipyard to meet every need of a diverse and
###### sophisticated global customer base.

Play

In 1957, Raymond Pearlson invented, patented and built the first shiplift, which he called
"Syncrolift". Over the following 65+ years, his invention has transformed the capabilities of
shipyards worldwide. Today, Pearlson Shiplift Corporation continues that legacy into the
twenty-first century with the most experienced team of shiplift engineers and technical support
specialists in the world.

[LEARN MORE][33]
[search-icon]

##### products

## Shiplift & Transfer Systems

Pearlson Shiplift Corporation specializes in the design, manufacture, servicing and ongoing support
of new and existing shiplifts and transfer systems. Our team has had experience designing and
supporting shiplifts and ship transfer systems worldwide for over 65 years.

[LEARN MORE][34]
[search-icon]

##### Installations

## Installations in Over 60 Countries

With recent orders for twelve (12) new shiplift systems, including four (4) facilities to support
the Superyacht Repair and Refit Industry, as well as two (2) of the Largest Shiplift Systems in both
North & South America in support of the U.S. Navy, Pearlson Shiplift Corporation continues its
legacy as the premier choice for shipyards all around the World.

[LEARN MORE][35]

#### #1Supplier

We are the sole provider of OEM Spare Parts, made in the USA

#### 6Decades

Our team has more than 65+ years of experience in Shiplift Systems

#### 70+Countries

We have installations in over 70+ countries around the world.

#### 200+Installations

We service and support more than 250+ installations around the world.

## How It Works Videos

We are the only company in the world that is devoted exclusively to the design, manufacture and
support of shiplift and transfer systems.

### Marina Barcelona 92

###### MB92 Superyacht Refit offers professional superyacht refit after sales, service and repair

Play

### VARD Tulcea

###### Established in 1975, VARD Tulcea is one of the premier shipbuilding yards in the World,
