# Testoni, carburanti a Sassari 
# e in tutta la Sardegna

La dedizione costante della famiglia Testoni si riflette sulla loro attività di vendita e trasporto
di carburanti in tutto il territorio sardo.  Nata negli anni Sessanta, ai suoi esordi l'attività si
focalizzava su quelle che allora erano le fonti energetiche primarie, ovvero carbone, legna e oli
combustibili per forni e caldaie.

Grazie a un'attività incessante, unita alla maturazione di un know-how aziendale di pluriennale
eperienza, l'azienda ora vanta un volume di vendita annuale che si aggira intorno ai 65 milioni di
litri e un personale di 43 dipendenti.  
 Il parco mezzi di Testoni conta 35 automezzi su tutto il territorio Sardo, che servono la clientela
a domicilio. È tuttavia possibile visitare l'azienda per rifornirsi di piccole quantità di
carburante. 

Data l'insularità del territorio, l'azienda si è affermata anche sul mercato nautico, rifornendo
carburante per yacht e imbarcazioni sia con servizio a bordo sia nei punti mare convenzionati con il
marchio BUNKER POINT nelle località di Porto Torres, Palau, Poltu Quatu, Baia Caddinas, Golfo
Aranci, Sant'Antioco, Pula., Calasetta, Marina di Capitana e Marina di Perd'e Sali.

## Carburanti, gasolio e oli combustibili

L'azienda Testoni di Sassari è specializzata in particolare nella vendita di carburante per uso
agricolo, trazione e riscaldamento. Si commercializza combustibile ad alto potere calorico e a basso
impatto ambientale, per rispettare l'ambiente. 

Inoltre si dedica alla vendita di oli combustibili densi e fluidi.  Offre servizio di comodato d'uso
di serbatoi. 

## Il marchio Bunker, garanzia di qualità

Il marchio Bunker Point è, nel settore bunkeraggio per nautica, garanzia di qualità. Testoni lo
svolge in tutta la Sardegna presso i punti convenzionati e autorizzati nei principali porti della
Sardegna e in particolare in tutta la Costa Smeralda.
[][22]

# Providing marine fuels and decarbonisation solutions around the globe

Building on Vitol’s long-standing presence across global bunkering markets, we supply bunker fuels
to ship and fleet owners around the world.

[View our locations][8] [Contact us][9]

#### A global marine fuel network

Working collaboratively we have built successful and long-term partnerships with producers, refiners
and distributors worldwide.

With a long-established network of operations across all major shipping and trading locations we
offer a reliable supply of marine fuels to ship and fleet owners around the world.

Our operational scale, underpinned by the technical and logistical knowledge of our people, has
established our reputation for consistency, quality and expertise.

#### We operate across all major shipping and trading locations

Our teams work collaboratively from key bunkering locations to understand local market dynamics and
requirements and find optimal marine fuel solutions for our customers.

Filter locations:
All locations Bunkers Refineries
CLIENT TESTIMONIAL

#### Why our customers choose us as their marine fuels supplier

Watch the video

[Customer video & testimonial] Play video
A diverse product portfolio

## Vitol Bunkers has established relationships with producers worldwide

We source high-quality products including marine fuel across multiple grades, bio-blends and offset
bunker fuels. Alongside our core offering of high-quality marine fuels, we are able to provide an
expanding range of decarbonisation solutions. Our product offering includes:

### Fuel oil (HSFO, ULSFO & VLSFO)

### Gas oil (LSMGO)

### Bio marine fuels

### Compliance

### LNG

[Find out more about our LNG offering][10]

A global network

#### Spanning five continents, our customers have access to a secure supply of stable product

Our operations are built upon a leased and proprietary network of physical refineries, storage
facilities and barges.

Strategically located blending facilities at key trading and bunkering hubs mean we can provide
bespoke specifications to meet our customers’ requirements.

Video

### Why use co-processed fuel to power your vessels?

In a world of increasingly complex decarbonisation regulation, co-processed, sustainability attached
VLSFO and LSMGO (co-pro) provides a compliant, familiar and simple solution for ship owners and
operators.

Our animated explainer dives deeper into Vitol’s co-processed, sustainability attached, and
regulatory compliant fuel.

Watch video
Case study

### Decarbonising shipping

Shipping is an integral part of international trade flows with over 80% of international trade
volumes carried by sea. To address this, the International Maritime Organisation has laid out
targets to entirely eliminate all shipping emissions by the end of the century with a shorter-term
target to halve total emissions by 2050. The EU has also set its own targets of a 55% reduction in
emissions by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2050.

[Read case study][11]
Insight

### FuelEU Maritime; what it means for shipping

The Fuel EU Maritime is the latest EU regulation aimed at the maritime sector, which came into force
on the 1st of January 2025. It is part of the European Union’s broader “Fit for 55” package of
legislation, which aims to reduce net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 compared to
1990 levels and achieve climate neutrality by 2050. Fuel EU Maritime is designed to incentivise the
uptake of lower-carbon alternative fuels in vessels by penalising the use of most conventional
fossil-based marine fuels.

[Read Vitol's insight][12]

Global solutions

#### Meeting the world’s critical and emerging energy needs

Serving the energy markets for almost six decades, today, Vitol has operations across every
continent where colleagues work collaboratively from over 40 offices to deliver energy solutions for
our customers.

[Learn more about Vitol][13]
